atAGlance: Nước ép dưa hấu is watermelon juice for humid days, light, juicy, softly sweet, and usually best when freshly blended.
whatItIs: Nước ép dưa hấu is fresh watermelon pressed or blended into juice. Expect watermelon juice that is light, juicy, icy, and softly sweet.
howToEnjoy: Ask for no sugar if the fruit is ripe.
howLocalsOrder: Nước ép dưa hấu is usually made or poured cold, so ask for no sugar, less sugar, or no ice before the glass is finished. Fresh fruit versions taste best when the flavor stays tart, pulpy, or fragrant.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước ép dưa hấu is a cooling drink for humid days when you want refreshment without cream or caffeine.
